summary: I left classroom teaching even though I love and miss it every day because there was no growth path. Talent got rewarded with extra responsibility while the guy across the hall made 30k more for pressing play on the VCR. Had no desire to be admin.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I left classroom teaching even though I love and miss it every day because there was no growth path. Talent got rewarded with extra responsibility while the guy across the hall made 30k more for pressing play on the VCR. Had no desire to be admin.
